evals.prompt: My SageMaker serverless endpoint has bad cold starts on the first request after it sits idle. Should we add provisioned concurrency? DescribeEndpointConfig shows ServerlessConfig MemorySizeInMB 4096, MaxConcurrency 5 and no ProvisionedConcurrency. ModelSetupTime has p99 about 9 seconds on the first request after 15 minutes idle, and no datapoints in busy hours. It runs in an account that isn't connected here, so answer from what I've told you.
evals.expected_output: A read-only review of the serverless endpoint that uses the ServerlessConfig and cold-start signals given (no ProvisionedConcurrency, ModelSetupTime p99 about 9 seconds after idle), distinguishes no datapoints from a measured zero, explains that on-demand serverless scales to zero so cold starts after idle are expected, and reports LLM-SM-SERVE-001 when sustained cold-start latency meets no Provisioned Concurrency. Adding Provisioned Concurrency is given as a command for the operator to run, with the tuning value marked workload-specific, and nothing is mutated.
assertions: The response uses the ServerlessConfig given, including that no ProvisionedConcurrency is set, before recommending a change
The response explains that on-demand serverless scales to zero, so a slow first request after idle is an expected cold start
The response distinguishes no datapoints from a measured zero when reading the cold-start signal
The response gives the Provisioned Concurrency change as a command for the operator to run and does not call any mutating API
